newsitem.title: USA: Yellen sees healthy US economy with low inflation.
newsitem.headline: Yellen sees healthy US economy with low inflation.

text.p: Federal Reserve Board member Janet Yellen, who was nominated Friday to head President Clinton's Council of Economic Advisers, said the U.S. economy was in good health.

"I am very fortunate to be joining your administration at a time when the economy is in extraordinarily good health with strong job creation and low inflation," she said at a news conference with Clinton and other cabinet appointees.
She said the economy's good health was due in part to efforts to substantially reduce the federal budget deficit.
